page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top: title block centred in roman capitals and italic lines; centre: printer's device (woodcut emblem); below: imprint centred. No margins with text.
page.l: De natura hominis iacentis in peccato, & gratia
Dei ex peccato euocantis omneis communiter, & suos excitantis singulariter,
Cum doctrina noua libelli recens admodum editi, cuius inscriptio,
DE CHRISTI SERVATORIS EFFICACITATE in omnibus & singulis hominibus, quatenus homines sunt, Assertio Catholica.
page.notes: Woodcut printer's device in the centre: an oval emblem with a hand and a book/table, inscribed with a motto around the rim (partly illegible). A handwritten mark at the top right corner and a stain on the right edge are not transcribed. The date is printed in old form: cIↄ. Iↄ. XCII = MDXCII.
